question: Which natural feature divides the Lakshadweep islands into two broad parts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nine Degree Channel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Nine Degree Channel** is a significant natural feature that geographically divides the **Lakshadweep Islands** into two broad parts: the northern group of islands and the southern group of islands.
 
• This channel is located between the islands of **Kalpeni (to the north)** and **Minicoy (to the south)**.
 
• The name "Nine Degree Channel" originates from its position near the **9°N latitude** in the Indian Ocean.
